candidate_presence_rule: A retained after p/support filter and consolidation; B saved candidates and consolidation
comparable_rule: shared exact library, B term tested, A term present or local membership available; differing known snapshots excluded
definition_source_rule: full evidence from available snapshots; absent definitions yield unknown totals and candidate-only partial evidence
direction_rule: compare unique retained A increased/decreased sign to B positive/negative; multiple A signs or B zero not meaningful
gene_count_rule: unique symbol per pathway at its strongest protein origin; non-candidate only if no candidate row
matching_rule: exact versioned library plus GO/Reactome ID if present, otherwise exact full term name; no fuzzy matching
protein_count_rule: each successfully tested row_position once per pathway
protein_level_rules: exclusive L1 q<.05 absFC>=1; L2 q<.05 .585<=absFC<1; L3 q<.05 absFC<.585; L4 p<.05 q>=.05 absFC>=.585; L5 p<.05 q>=.05 absFC<.585

route_a_metadata.absent_library_gene_rule: excluded from that library universe and submitted list; retained in universe audit
route_a_metadata.duplicate_rule: universe unique genes; candidates legacy strongest origin, q, p, row position before direction
route_a_metadata.method: one-sided upper-tail hypergeometric ORA (Fisher greater equivalent)
route_a_metadata.multiple_testing: BH per primary/exploratory branch over all nonempty measured terms, libraries and both directions including zero hits
route_a_metadata.source_policy: local JSON only; versioned library labels are supplied resource names, not verified release dates
route_a_metadata.universe_definition: unique valid symbols in complete successfully tested DA table intersect library annotation union

route_b_metadata.clustering_policy: separate directions; all measured pathway genes; q then p then library/name representative
route_b_metadata.direction_definition: sign of mean t; mixed_signs flags both signs; not pathway activity
route_b_metadata.duplicate_gene_rule: arithmetic mean of all eligible protein t-statistics
route_b_metadata.limitations: Ordinary, not moderated t. Competitive gene sampling assumes exchangeable genes; does not preserve inter-protein correlation. Signed mean may cancel mixed regulation.
route_b_metadata.pathway_testing_method: competitive mean-t gene sampling, two-sided equal-tail Monte Carlo

scalar_a_statistic_rule: lowest adjusted p then p/direction among all saved A directions; full records retained, not a combined p/q
warnings: No automatic evidence integration or AI reporting.
Category denotes saved candidate support, not validation or causal biology.
A_ONLY/B_ONLY with directly_comparable=false are coverage differences, not route disagreement.
